title: HIPAA Privacy, Security and Awareness
label: WELCOME  |  ELEVATE LEARN
tagline: Protecting patient information, from your first day
introSay: Welcome to HIPAA Privacy, Security and Awareness.

scenes.title: Patient information is protected
scenes.sub: It applies to you from your first day
scenes.lead: Many of our clients are healthcare organizations. When you work for them, you may see information about real patients. That information belongs to the patient, and HIPAA applies to you from your first day.

scenes.heading: What you will learn
scenes.lead: In this course, you will learn:

items.text: When it may be used or shared
items.say: When it may be shared, and how to share only the minimum.

items.text: What to do when something goes wrong
items.say: And what to do when something goes wrong.

items.label: Privacy Rule
items.say: Privacy: who may use or share it?

items.label: Security Rule
items.say: Security: how is it kept safe?

items.label: Breach Notification
items.say: Breach notification: who is told when it is exposed?

scenes.title: When in doubt, stop and ask
scenes.lead: When you are unsure, stop, do not share, and ask your team lead or your client contact. Asking is never a mistake. Let us begin.
